name: Prompt Quality Rubric
description: Example rubric for judging the quality of a user prompt. Copy this file, edit the dimensions/weights/scale to fit your needs, and upload it on a QC run. This sample is not auto-applied; a run only uses a rubric you upload.

dimensions.label: Clarity
dimensions.description: Is the intent unambiguous? Could a competent model misread it?

dimensions.label: Specificity
dimensions.description: Are the task, constraints, and expected output format stated?

dimensions.label: Context sufficiency
dimensions.description: Is enough background given to complete the task well?

dimensions.label: Structure
dimensions.description: Is it organised so the most important instructions are easy to find?

dimensions.label: Safety & scope
dimensions.description: Does it avoid disallowed, manipulative, or out-of-scope requests?
